label: Read the complete materialized arist phys viii 1 Greek witness
summary: Read the complete materialized ARIST-PHYS-VIII-1 Greek witness (250b11-252b6). At 251a8-16 Aristotle requires a subject capable of each particular motion. Recorded the capacity requirement over existing beings/respects predicates with a physical-respect guard. Rejected identifying it with the broader prima-via premise: that would extend physical motion to all reduction from potency to act. Also rejected extracting temporal priority from the timeless type; the combustible/burner priority at 251a15-16 and subsequent everlasting-motion arguments remain in the same candidate. The opening question is context. The substantive Anaxagoras/Empedocles survey is outside this proposition and remains explicitly unprocessed in the same candidate; no claim of independent proof, premise discharge or chapter completion.
